subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated GPU runway, isolation & SLA next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbuslabs.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated GPU runway, isolation & SLA next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps so we keep momentum.

Key pain points you shared:
- Peak inference latency spikes during batch inference windows impacting user-facing freshness.
- Regulatory constraints: PHI in requests; need HIPAA-aligned data handling and tenant isolation.
- Cost predictability for Q4 rollout and predictable throughput for the analytics pipeline.

Primary goals we heard:
- Support the analytics pipeline at sustained ~400k tokens/sec peak with headroom for 2x burst.
- P95 latency target in the 100–150ms range for the primary generation path.
- Dedicated isolation (VPC + tenant-only pool) with optional burst into a shared pool for spikes.

What we propose (high level):
- Dedicated reserved GPU pool sized to handle sustained baseline with a 2x burst plan.
- Tenant isolation via a private VPC/private control plane + optional encrypted KV cache.
- SLA targets: 99.9% availability for dedicated pool; latency SLOs we’ll validate in an ops deep-dive.

Attachments: Nimbus-sizing.xlsx (initial sizing worksheet), SOC2-summary.pdf (Redwood attestation excerpt).

Next steps (can we agree timelines?):
1) You confirm procurement timeline and legal contact (you mentioned 4–6 weeks).
2) We schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with engineering to validate throughput/latency assumptions — proposed slots Wed/Thu this week.
3) Security handoff: I'll loop Naomi from Security for the compliance questionnaire and PHI specifics.
4) I’ll prepare a ballpark commercial estimate after the deep-dive; Ben (cc) will lead contracting.

Please reply with any corrections to the recap and which time works for the deep-dive.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Nimbus-sizing.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-summary.pdf (doc stub)

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbuslabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Dedicated GPU runway, isolation & SLA next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. This matches our notes closely. A few clarifications from our side:

- Throughput: baseline sustained ~250k tokens/sec, with peak bursts up to ~500k tokens/sec during batch windows (roughly 45–60 minutes). Concurrent user-facing sessions typically 40–60.
- Latency: we want p95 <= 150ms for generation requests; p99 target if possible but lower priority.
- Compliance: PHI will be present in ~30% of requests. We need HIPAA controls + audit logs retained for 1 year.
- Procurement: Procurement expects a PO and SOW within 6 weeks to hit our Q4 roadmap; legal contact is priya.singh@nimbuslabs.com.

One ask: can you provide a ballpark monthly committed cost range for a 12–18 month reserved commitment (ballpark only so we can align budget)?

We’re good to move on the technical deep-dive — Wed 10:00am PT works for our eng lead.

—Jordan
Jordan Price
Head of ML Infrastructure, Nimbus Labs
jordan.price@nimbuslabs.com

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Dedicated GPU runway, isolation & SLA next steps

Jordan / Priya —

Appreciate the clarifications — that helps a lot. Quick answers and a refined proposal outline below.

Ballpark commercial (pre-deep-dive):
- For a 12–18 month reserved commitment sized to handle the baseline + 2x burst headroom, estimate range: $55k–$85k/month depending on exact GPU mix (A100s vs H100-like family), networking, and retention choices.
- We'll produce a more precise quote after the tech deep-dive and sizing worksheet confirmation.

Operational proposal (what Redwood would deliver):
- Dedicated reserved pool (single-tenant) with VPC peering and private control plane.
- Optional encrypted KV cache retained in-customer region; audit logs with 1y retention for HIPAA requests.
- Burst strategy: autoscale into a controlled shared overflow pool with throttling and priority rules to protect the dedicated SLA.
- SLAs: 99.9% uptime for the dedicated pool; latency SLOs we will instrument during the PoC and commit to p95 targets in the final SLO doc.

Action items / owners:
- Technical deep-dive (Wed 10:00am PT) — Marissa / Redwood infra eng + Nimbus infra eng (Jordan) — confirm meeting invite.
- Security questionnaire + dataflow review — Naomi Feldman (security) will own from Redwood; Priya will be our legal/compliance counterpart.
- Commercial/contracting — Ben Carter will prepare an initial SOW & T&Cs and a draft estimate to land in your procurement process.

Please confirm Wed 10:00am PT and we’ll send calendar invites + an agenda. I’ll drop the sizing worksheet link (attached) into the invite for pre-work.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Nimbus-sizing.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Nimbus Labs — owners & immediate asks (procurement + security)

Ben / Naomi —

Looping you both in so we have clear owners on the next items after this morning’s follow-up with Nimbus Labs (Jordan / Priya). Summary and asks below —

Summary: Nimbus needs a dedicated reserved GPU pool with tenant isolation and HIPAA-aligned audit logs. Baseline throughput ~250k tokens/sec with peaks up to 500k tokens/sec. Procurement wants a PO/SOW in ~6 weeks.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: please draft a preliminary SOW + 12/18 month pricing band (use the $55–85k/month ballpark) and include options for A100-equivalent vs H100-equivalent mixes. We should call out burst pricing and shared-pool overflow rules.
- Naomi: start the security questionnaire thread; we need to confirm logging/AUDIT retention (1 year), KMS integration approach, and whether we can support encrypted KV cache in their region. Also flag any potential HIPAA gotchas (PHI transmission patterns).
- Marissa (me): I’ll schedule the Wed 10:00am PT deep-dive and include the sizing worksheet and a brief agenda (throughput targets, model sequences, KV cache needs, acceptance tests).

Timeline: deep-dive Wed 10:00am PT, expect follow-up SOW within 5 business days after deep-dive. Procurement wants commercial terms within 6 weeks.

Thanks —

Marissa

[Internal only — do not forward outside Redwood until legal approves the draft SOW]
